temporalPolicy: Only exact starting timestamps or complete intervals contained within one local date and six-hour bucket. Other times remain in the source snapshot and exclusion audit, not assigned a fabricated hour.
weighting: Equal weight per eligible complaint. No SSP severity weights, recency weighting, driving weights, or population/footfall denominators.
normalization: v / (v + q), q = max(1, nearest-rank p90 of positive smoothed values in planning-bounds cells across four buckets)
